new_value: Host CTest lichen/tests/desync_fsm consumes all four ccp16-desync.json vectors against the C implementations: desync_on_sfn_wrap (SYNCED + invalid provider at wrap -> DESYNCED, recovery restart, 3-superframe timeout), multi_root_version_conflict_desync (RPL version event -> DRIFTING/unsynced + SFN reset per 2a.5.4), excessive_clock_drift_desync (lichen_drift_holdover_expired 12000>5000 ppm + magnitude/boundary), desync_recovery_beacon_revalidate (first valid beacon -> RECOVERING). Vectors loaded from the committed JSON at run time via a bounded hand-rolled scanner (name-located case extraction, per-key int/string fields); missing/malformed file fails closed. Gates: ctest green under ASan/UBSan, gcc -Werror -Wconversion clean, cppcheck clean. Reviews via kimi-k3: pass1 correctness found 2 low findings (doc overclaim re on_missed_superframe — now actually driven incl. timeout; skip-exit-77 not registered as CTest skip — made explicitly fail-closed with a documented no-SKIP policy); pass2 security PASS (bounded scanner, no unbounded loops, nothing attacker-reachable); pass3 edge timed out twice (300s/600s) -> self-review fallback: malformed/duplicate-name handling verified fail-closed, sequences match python sfn.py oracle. Note: native_sim run not needed — suite is host CTest; the needs-linux/native_sim concern is satisfied by the same convention as tdma_guard_budget/tdma_root_select.
